newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells HRK 161 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells HRK 161 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 161 million kuna in 35- and 91-day liquidity bills on Wednesday, compared to only 43 million at the last weekly auction.
The rates were flat at 7.50 and 9.0 percent, respectively and there were no bids again for longest 182-day bills.
Monday's reserve payment drained a total of 3.39 billion kuna from the banking sector, an official told Reuters.
This was some 66 million less than under a previous fortnightly requirement as bank accounts sank to a lower level at the end of last week due to tax and benefit payments.
